parameters.description:
`msg-to-googlechat` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Google Chat space — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your space's incoming webhook URL, sending the message as the webhook's `text` field with the title on its own line above the body — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Google Chat spaces bound per enrollment.

In Google Chat, open the space you want to notify, choose Apps & integrations from the space menu, select Manage webhooks, give the webhook a name, and click Save. Copy the resulting Webhook URL — it looks like https://chat.googleapis.com/v1/spaces/<SPACE>/messages?key=<KEY>&token=<TOKEN> — and paste the whole URL into the GOOGLECHAT_WEBHOOK_URL secret.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Google Chat destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

webhook_url_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Google Chat webhook URL
